metadata.name: Scroll a web page
metadata.author: recued-core
metadata.description: Use “Scroll a web page” in Recued. Scroll an open page a screen at a time, as Page Down does, and leave it there: next, previous, top, bottom, or screen 1, 2, 3 from its top; a panel or element by ref or selector. For a feed or a long list that loads as you scroll. Answers which screen of how many, and what changed. Changes nothing on the page.

to.help: next scrolls one screen down, previous one up, top and bottom to the ends. Ignored when screen is given.
to.label: To

ref.help: The ref of a panel or list to scroll instead of the page, such as e12, from the latest inspection. Leave it empty when passing a selector.
ref.label: Element

page.help: The page's address, such as https://example.com/orders, whether a tab shows it or not: with none showing it, the page is opened in a new tab first, which asks you unless allowed on that site. Or a page handle a listing, an opening, a read or an action answered, copied exactly.
page.label: Page

screen.help: A screen to scroll to, counted from 1 at the top, in place of to. 0 uses to.
screen.label: Screen

selector.help: A CSS selector for a panel or list to scroll instead of the page, such as #inbox. Leave it empty for the page, or to name it by ref.
selector.label: Part of the page
